html: The Nana are an Aboriginal Australian group of the Western Desert of Western Australia, shown on the map from 1600 to 1815 in the country east of Wiluna. The name has been used for the Ngaanyatjarra together with the Pini, so the label may cover several desert peoples. They belong to the Western Desert cultural bloc. Their neighbours on the map are the Tjalkanti to the east and the Koara and Tjupan to the west.
